title: The specified model compact-support comparison is the proper-unit map
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $f=a_X:X\to s$. Let $\Phi$ be the $k$-linear model Frobenius, the base change of the $q$-power Frobenius of $X_0$, and let $h=\Phi^r$, $r\geq1$. Write $\mathcal D_T=D^b_c(T)[[\underline\Omega]]$ for the actual bounded constructible module-object category with $\underline\Omega=\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Use its restricted derived pullback/direct-image adjunction [sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors] with this coefficient ring, and its chosen-compactification functor $P=Rf_!^{\mathrm{cond}}$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek].

For $M\in\mathcal D_X$, define the proper-unit map $d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,M}:PM\to PLh^*M$ by the ordered composite
$$PM\xrightarrow{P(\eta_{h,M})}PRh_*Lh^*M\xrightarrow{P(Rh_*\simeq Rh_!)}PRh_!Lh^*M\xrightarrow{\mathrm{comp}}R(fh)_!Lh^*M\xrightarrow{fh=f}PLh^*M.$$
Here $\eta_h$ is the unit of $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$, and every proper-coincidence and composition comparison is the one used by the module-object compact-support construction, including comparison with the chosen compactifications. Properness holds because $h$ is a positive iterate of finite model Frobenius [lem-trf-scheme-frobenius-finite-radicial]. Let $\Theta_{h,M}:PM\to PLh^*M$ be the underlying arrow of the specific compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison used to define weilCompactCohomology for $h$ in [nt-assume-trace-formula], after the canonical identity pullback on $s$ is removed. Then
$$\Theta_{h,M}=d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,M}.$$
This equality is natural in $M$. In particular the globalOperator of any Weil object $(M,w:Lh^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M)$ in that interface is $P(w)\circ d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,M}$. No adic coefficients, geometric Galois Frobenius, trace identity, or duality is asserted.

source.place: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison, weilCompactCohomology and WeilBoundedConstructibleOfEnd.globalOperator (the archive cited by nt-assume-trace-formula). The definition of compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison is literally the composite: identity pullback on s (boundedConstructibleUpperStarId with unitors), the unit of boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction for Phi, the inverse of boundedConstructibleLowerShriekIsoLowerStar_padicAlgCl, the inverse of boundedConstructibleLowerShriekComp_padicAlgCl, and eqToIso for Phi >> a_X = a_X; weilCompactCohomology is IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso of it and globalOperator is its frobenius.hom for the m-th iterate between eqToHom casts. Read by the maintainer reader in the read-only checkout lean/WeilConjectures/TraceFormula/Statement.lean, lines 108-148 and 182-196, whose declarations and docstrings are those named by nt-assume-trace-formula. The asserted equality is the unfolding of this definition; the blueprint counterpart of the recipe is sec-trace-formula/sk-d-weil/_section.md (global graph-operator paragraph) and prop-trf-graph-operator.proof.md.

proof.text: Work with the actual module-object categories, not an adic or discrete-coefficient replacement. The coefficient ring and bounded constructible category are those of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] and [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. By [sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors], the restricted adjunction is $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$, with unit $\eta_h:\mathrm{id}\to Rh_*Lh^*$. By [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek], $P$ means the lower shriek for the chosen compactification of $f$. Denote by $c_h:Rh_*\to Rh_!$ the inverse of the specified proper comparison, by $\alpha_{f,h}:PRh_!\to R(fh)_!$ the specified composition comparison, and by $e_h:R(fh)_!\to P$ the equality-induced comparison for $fh=f$. Thus the arrow defined in the statement is $d_{h,M}^{\mathrm{cond}}=(e_h)_{Lh^*M}(\alpha_{f,h})_{Lh^*M}P((c_h)_{Lh^*M})P(\eta_{h,M})$. This is a naming of the maps already fixed in the statement; no new choice of comparisons is made.

source.place: Definition of the restricted compact-support composite; notation for the specified maps in the item statement

proof.text: By [lem-trf-scheme-frobenius-finite-radicial], $\Phi$ is finite. To check the iterate rather than assume its properness, induct on $r\geq1$: the base case is $\Phi$ itself, and if $\Phi^r$ is finite, [lem-weil-pbc-finite-composition] applied to $\Phi^r$ and $\Phi$ makes $\Phi^{r+1}$ finite. Thus $h$ is finite and is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-proper]. Also $fh=f$, since $\Phi$ and all its iterates are morphisms over $s$. These are exactly the geometric conditions needed by the proper comparison and the final equality comparison in the recipe. The model is allowed to be non-reduced and $X$ need not be proper over $s$.

proof.text:
Use the concrete model-Weil compact-support interface named in [nt-assume-trace-formula], without invoking its trace equality. Expand its $\operatorname{compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison}$ according to the definition recipe recorded in this item's source field. With $I_s=L\operatorname{id}_s^*$, its underlying map at $M$ is
$$I_s(PM)\xrightarrow{u_{PM}}PM\xrightarrow{P(\eta_{h,M})}PRh_*Lh^*M\xrightarrow{P((c_h)_{Lh^*M})}PRh_!Lh^*M\xrightarrow{(\alpha_{f,h})_{Lh^*M}}R(fh)_!Lh^*M\xrightarrow{(e_h)_{Lh^*M}}PLh^*M.$$
Here $u$ is precisely the canonical identity-pullback isomorphism (including its unitors). Removing the initial identity pullback means precomposing this displayed map by $u_{PM}^{-1}$. The two adjacent maps $u_{PM}$ and $u_{PM}^{-1}$ cancel. What remains is the four-factor expression of Step 1, in the same order, so $\Theta_{h,M}=d_{h,M}^{\mathrm{cond}}$. The only expansion here is of the named implementation definition; in particular the proper and composition comparisons are not replaced by arbitrary isomorphisms having the same endpoints.

source.place: compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison definition recipe transcribed in the item source record (archive WANTED locally); identity-pullback removal is the explicit cancellation above

proof.text: For $v:M\to N$, naturality of the four transformations in Step 1 gives, in order, $Rh_*Lh^*(v)\eta_{h,M}=\eta_{h,N}v$ and the three corresponding naturality squares for $c_h,\alpha_{f,h},e_h$. Whisker the first square by $P$, then compose the four squares. The result is $PLh^*(v)d_{h,M}^{\mathrm{cond}}=d_{h,N}^{\mathrm{cond}}P(v)$. This proves the asserted naturality. Finally the Weil compact-support object in [nt-assume-trace-formula] has underlying object $PM$. In the recorded recipe for $\operatorname{weilCompactCohomology}$, applying $\operatorname{IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso}$ to a Weil structure $w:Lh^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ gives the structure arrow $P(w)\Theta_{h,M}$ after the same identity pullback is removed; $\operatorname{globalOperator}$ takes this arrow. Substitute Step 3 to obtain $P(w)d_{h,M}^{\mathrm{cond}}$. This is an expansion of the construction, not an application of a trace formula or an identification with a Galois action.

lean.statement: theorem modelCompactComparison_eq_properUnit (hΦ : IsModelFrobenius Φ f₀ π) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) : modelCompactComparisonWithoutIdentity ℓ hΦ r = modelCompactProperUnit ℓ hΦ r ∧ (∀ (M N : Dᵇc(X.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧) (v : M ⟶ N), (boundedConstructibleLowerShriek (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ (toPoint X)).map v ≫ (modelCompactProperUnit ℓ hΦ r).app N = (modelCompactProperUnit ℓ hΦ r).app M ≫ (boundedConstructibleLowerShriek (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ (toPoint X)).map ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ (frobeniusIterate Φ r)).map v)) ∧ (∀ K : WeilBoundedConstructibleOfEnd ℓ (frobeniusIterate Φ r), modelCompactGlobalOperator ℓ hΦ r K = (modelCompactProperUnit ℓ hΦ r).app K.carrier ≫ (boundedConstructibleLowerShriek (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ (toPoint X)).map K.str.hom)
